title: A Crash Course in Modern Hardware by Cliff Click
summary: Cliff Click walks through a small performance example on a modern out-of-order CPU. He covers pipelining, ILP, CISC vs RISC, multicore, and why cache misses and the memory subsystem dominate performance.
why: Recommended as an accessible refresher on how modern hardware and caches affect software performance.

quote.text: it's a really accessible refresher if you're a bit outdated on how all these caches work and interact
